name: Text as a whole
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulations (EC) No 261/2004, (EC) No 1107/2006, (EU) No 1177/2010, (EU) No 181/2011 and (EU) 2021/782 as regards enforcement of passenger rights in the Union
part_text:
The report sets out Parliament's position on new EU-wide rules for enforcing passenger rights on planes, trains, buses and ships. It wants national enforcement bodies to be independent, able to investigate and fine companies, and to handle individual complaints. It also asks for clearer complaint handling, a common claim form, better rights for disabled passengers and their mobility equipment, and clearer rules on refunds when tickets are bought through intermediaries.

- **What changes:** Stronger enforcement bodies, a common claim form, and clearer refund and complaint rules.
- **Who it affects:** Air, rail, bus and ship passengers, carriers, ticket intermediaries and national authorities.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's position goes to the Council for negotiations on the final law.
